requirements.statement: After a base merge, a path whose content at the head equals the base tip, and which the feature never touched at the anchor, does not fail custody; a path the feature changed, or a conflict resolution rewrote, still fails it. Must pass: yes.
requirements.source: TRD Objectives O1 (#85 part 2; brief Expected 1)

requirements.statement: `.claude/verification-notes.md` (framework-written verifier notes) never counts as shipped code. Must pass: yes.
requirements.source: TRD Objectives O2 (#85 part 3; brief Expected 2)

requirements.statement: The push step is not gated by custody; custody gates the merge (and the release): the merge step runs the custody gate before `gh pr merge`, and a gate failure leaves the PR unmerged. Must pass: yes.
requirements.source: TRD Objectives O3 (#85 part 1, #86; brief Expected 3)

requirements.statement: A preview criterion can be proven after the push: the re-verification happens inside the merge step, on a head that is already pushed, and the run then re-anchors. Must pass: yes.
After the PR has merged, the run record (`shipped.json`) is written to an untracked file under the git directory, needs no commit, and is still read after the branch is deleted. Must pass: yes.
requirements.source: TRD Objectives O5 (#85 part 4; brief Expected 4)

requirements.statement: Re-verification after a base merge is handed the feature's owner/PM rulings, and a must-pass criterion whose evidence covers only files unchanged between the old anchor and the merge head is reused, not re-verified. Must pass: no.
The re-anchor never leaves the merge head mismatched: nothing is committed or pushed between the custody gate and `gh pr merge`, which matches the PR's own head. Must pass: yes.
Every changed file under `packages/core/` has an identical vendored copy under `.claude/`. Must pass: no.

tasks.description: custody.js: ignore framework-written files; base-aware compare with an excused list; reconcile --base <ref> --head <sha> with the base-merge move, local-HEAD refusal, covers-based affected set, reused list, and guarded --reason format; CLI flags and usage; tests in custody.test.js. Serves O1, O2, O4, O6, O7. Dependencies: none. Acceptance: ten new tests fail on current code and pass after (base-only files move anchor with base-merge; feature edit still differing; conflict-resolved and base-took-wholesale files still differing; verification-notes ignored; base change to a must-pass covers path reverifies; untouched covers in reused; --head judges that commit and refuses when local HEAD has shipped change; --reason format guarded; --set-only sets absent anchor only; no-covers must-pass in ids; anchor at head plus .trd-state-only commit passes pr-head).

ship-sequencer.js: the detach-on contract key; external record path under git rev-parse --git-common-dir; loadState prefers it; saveState writes it once detached; record/status report recordPath; tests in ship-sequencer.test.js. Serves O5. Dependencies: none. Acceptance: new tests fail before and pass after (detach-on writes <common dir>/ensemble/ship/<name>/shipped.json and later records do not touch tracked file; status reads detached record after branch deletion; outside a git repo the tracked file is used; a contract without the key is unchanged; a new run with a different startedAt never reads the old external record).

Contracts: new ship-custody-gate.md (non-primitive). push loses reconcile and push-link; open-pr loses push-link check; merge runs the gate (--base origin/<base> --head <PR headRefOid>) before pr-head, commits nothing before gh pr merge, declares detach-on: merged; release runs the gate before releasing; run and fix-findings wording follows; fix-findings treats reverify from format reconcile as go on. Update ship-primitives.test.js. Serves O3, O4, O7. Dependencies: FIX-001, FIX-002. Acceptance: ship-primitives.test.js asserts (1) push runs only reconcile --set-only and no --link push, open-pr has no --link push; (2) in merge the gate precedes the gh pr view state read and --link pr-head, which precedes gh pr merge, and a gate stop returns before gh pr merge; (3) gate runs /verify-build <work.trd> --criteria <ids> --no-fix --chained after the head is on the PR, then --reverified; (4) merge forbids commit or push between gate and gh pr merge; (5) merge front matter carries detach-on: merged and every contract loads; (6) release runs the gate before its command with local HEAD; (7) gate polls headRefOid before reconciling and fetches the base.

Commands: verify-build.md --criteria folds the plan's owner rulings and accepted-as-not-verifiable rulings into notes. ship-build.md Step 5: after a merge nothing is committed and the readout names the detached record path; the commit-state-directory NEXT line goes. Text tests. Serves O5, O6. Dependencies: FIX-002, FIX-003. Acceptance: text assertions in ship-primitives.test.js or a sibling test fail before and pass after (verify-build --criteria section names ## Owner rulings and ## Accepted as not verifiable going into notes; ship-build no longer tells the owner to commit the state directory on the default branch after a merge and names the record under the git directory).

Mirror every changed packages/core/ file into .claude/ (lib/custody.js, lib/ship-sequencer.js, the contracts including the new gate, commands/verify-build.md, commands/ship-build.md) and run the battery. Serves O8. Dependencies: FIX-001, FIX-002, FIX-003, FIX-004. Acceptance: bats test/integration/tests/runtime-integrity.test.sh passes; npx jest on custody.test.js, ship-primitives.test.js and ship-sequencer.test.js passes.

open_questions: OQ-1 | Should the base excuse also require that the feature never touched the path (condition b)? | Assumed: yes. It is stricter than the brief, so it is within the call Forge took. | owner-only

OQ-2 | After a base-only change, should a must-pass criterion with no evidence covers record be re-verified? | Assumed: yes, re-verified, because it cannot show its sources are untouched. This costs a re-check per base merge for such criteria. | owner-only

OQ-3 | A new non-primitive contract file and a new detach-on front-matter key are architecture-shaped changes. | Assumed: taken as a routine engineering call under Forge's charter (OWNER-CALL), not yet reviewed by the owner. | owner-only
could_not_verify: No live GitHub merge, Vercel preview or branch protection was exercised; O3, O4 and O7 are proven on contract text and on custody.js against a local bare origin.
A detached record cannot be seen from a fresh CI runner, which matters only for resuming after the merge (accepted in the owner's call).
After the branch and worktree are gone, custody.json is gone too, so a release resumed then stops with "no anchor" (safe: it stops before releasing).
